title: Seed samples Syria's genebank deposited vs. withdrew after its Aleppo facility became unreachable

source.name: Syrian War Prompts First Withdrawal From Arctic Seed Vault

notes: ICARDA (based near Aleppo, Syria) deposited 116,484 seed samples 2008-2014. When war made its own genebank unreachable, it withdrew a matching set across three withdrawals (2015, 2017, 2019) -- the vault's first-ever withdrawals -- to rebuild its collection elsewhere.

points.label: Withdrawn After War Cut Off Access
